main.name: Engr. Prof. J. K. Odusote
main.brief:
Prof. Jamiu Kolawole Odusote is a Professor in the Department of Materials and Metallurgical Engineering, University of Ilorin, Nigeria. His research interests include Materials development & characterization, corrosion and high-temperature oxidation, casting and alloy development, waste valorization, and biomass to energy materials (fuels). He has published several articles in high-impact journals and participated in numerous conferences, workshops, and seminars. Prof. Odusote is a Registered Engineer with the Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria, a Corporate Member of the Nigerian Society of Engineers, a Fellow of the Nigerian Institution of Materials, Mining and Metallurgical Engineers (NIMMME), and a member of several other professional bodies within and outside Nigeria. He is currently the Dean of the Faculty of Engineering and Technology.

His major focus is on corrosion protection and control and has published several articles in high impact journals and presentation in conferences and workshops. He is a reviewer for reputable international journals. Prof. I. I. Ahmed is a corporate member of Nigerian Society of Engineers and a Registered Engineer with Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria.

main.name: Engr. Dr. T. D. Akpenpuun
main.dept: Dept. of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering
main.brief:
Dr. Timothy Denen Akpenpuun is a Lecturer in the Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Engineering and Technology, University of Ilorin, Ilorin, Nigeria. He specialises in Farm Structures and Environmental Engineering. His research interests are controlled environment agriculture (CEA), greenhouse climate simulation, greenhouse energy simulation, agricultural waste management, and agro-meteorology. Dr. Akpenpuun is a registered engineer with the Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN), a Corporate member of the Nigerian Institution of Agricultural Engineers (NIAE), and a Corporate Member of the Korean Society for Biological Environment Control (KSBEC). Dr. Akpenpuun is a reviewer for local and international journals. He has authored several scientific articles published in reputable journal outlets.

main.name: Engr. Dr. A. O. Otuoze
main.brief: Dr. Abdulrahaman Okino Otuoze is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Faculty of Engineering and Technology (FET), University of Ilorin, Nigeria. His research interests include Electrical Power System, Smart Grid Security, Energy Efficiency, Renewable Energy Technology, and Electrical Machine Dr. Otuoze teaches various courses at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels while also undertaking research in the same field. His research interests include renewable energy systems, power systems protection covering smart grid security, electricity theft detections, as well as designs of advanced electrical machines. Dr. Otuoze has authored and co-authored several articles in high impact journals and presentations in conferences, workshops and seminars. He is also an active reviewer for many reputable national and international journal outlets. Dr. Otuoze is a Registered Engineer, Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria, Corporate Member, Nigerian Society of Engineers and member of several other professional bodies within and outside Nigeria.

She has published several articles in high impact journals and presentations in conferences, workshops and seminars in her area of specialisation. She is a reviewer for Elsevier, Springer and others. main.name: Engr. Prof. (Mrs.) N. T. Surajudeen-Bakinde
main.dept: Dept. of Electrical and Electronics Engineering
main.brief:
Prof. Nazmat Toyin Surajudeen-Bakinde had her Bachelor of Engineering and Masters of Engineering in 1997 and 2004 respectively from the same department where she works. She was awarded Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering and Electronics in 2010 from University of Liverpool in United Kingdom. Prof. Surajudeen-Bakinde specializes in Telecommunications and has published in reputable journals and book chapters with over eighty papers to her credit. She is also a reviewer for local and international journals. She has won grants with her research teams and conducted different impactful researches. Her current research interests include Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Technology for Short Range and High Speed Communications Systems, Channel Equalization and Signal Detection in Wireless Communications Systems, Internet of Things for Home Automation Systems, Television White Space for Providing different Services, Propagation Models for Mobile Personal Communication System, Colocation of multiple wireless base stations, Spectrum Measurements, Terrestrial Radio Propagation, Computation Intelligence in Radio Propagation, Energy Savings in Heterogeneous Networks, Telemedicine, Information and Communication Technologies for Teaching and Learning and Sustainable Energy Diversity.In her profession, Prof. Surajudeen-Bakinde is a registered member of the Council for the Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN) and one of the examiners of COREN registration exercise for corporate members. She has also been appointed as a resource person in the COREN accreditation of engineering programmes in some Universities and Polytechnics in Nigeria. Internationally, Prof. Nazmat is registered with the Institution of Engineering and Technology (IET), UK and the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), USA. At home, she is a registered member of the Nigerian Institute of Electrical and Electronic Engineers (NIEEE), Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE). She is equally a member of the Association of Professional Women Engineers of Nigeria (APWEN) and was the Chairperson of Ilorin branch for two years.
Nazmat has equally served the nation in various capacities as resource person for curriculum development and review under National Board for Technical Education, Kaduna, Kaduna State, Development Research Project Centre (dRPC) and United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) in partnership with Nigerian Educational Research and Development Council (NERDC). She was a member, Evaluation Committee for the Telecommunications-Based Research Innovations Proposals from the Academics in Nigerian Tertiary Institutions submitted to Nigerian Communications Commission (NCC), Abuja, Nigeria for three years.She has served the University in various positions at the departmental, faculty and university levels, locally and internationally. Prof. Surajudeen-Bakinde was an Assistant Director (Administration), Centre for International Education of the University of Ilorin. She was a Level Adviser, a Postgraduate Coordinator, Acting Head of Department, Member of Quality Assurance Committee in the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering. She is presently heading some committees in the Faculty of Engineering and Technology (FET), like Faculty of Engineering and Technology International Conference for 2024, FET Alumni Committee, FET Welfare Committee, FET Ethical Review Committee. A member of the FET Mock Accreditation Committee and FET Outcome Based Education Committee. At the University level, Prof Surajudeen-Bakinde is a representative of the faculty on the Academic Planning and Curriculum Committee. Member, University Mock Accreditation Committee. She is the Senate Representative on Research Grant Committee. She is an Hall Mistress at The Atlantic Height Private Hostel. Prof. Nazmat is an Adviser to a few students body such as APWEN Unilorin Collegiate, Nigerian Universities Engineering Students’ Association (NUESA), Nigerian Association of Electrical and Electronics Engineering Students (NAEEES), Offa Students Union, Unilorin Chapter.

main.name: Engr. Prof. H. A. Ajimotokan
main.brief:
Habeeb A. AJIMOTOKAN (PhD, REng) is a Professor of Thermal/Fluid Power, Energy and Process Engineering at the Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Ilorin. His research interest is in specific or subspecialty areas of Thermal and Fluid Power Engineering, Renewable Energy and Systems; Thermochemical Decomposition; Heat Recovery-to-Power Technologies; Material Energy Efficiency and Sustainability; Process Simulation and Optimisation; Engineering Education; and Nigerian Content Development. He is a Registered Engineer of the Council for Regulation of Engineering in Nigeria (COREN); Member, Nigerian Society of Engineers (NSE); and Member, Nigerian Institution of Mechanical Engineers (NIMechE), among others. His scholarly prowess, contributions to contemporary research, knowledge and consultancy services are evident in his several publications of peer-reviewed scientific articles, books and book chapters in reputable outlets of international standard; and several industry research and technology development contracts.

Prio to her joining Northumbria University, she is a full professor at the Department of Materials and Metallurgical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering, University of Ilorin. main.name: Engr. Dr. (Mrs.) O. A. Mokuolu
main.dept: Dept. of Water Resources and Environmental Engineering
main.brief:
Dr. Mokuolu is a Lecturer, Researcher and a mentor at the Department of Water Resources and Environmental Engineering, University of Ilorin. She has publications in reputable journals and presented papers in international conferences. She is experienced in circular economy, solid waste engineering and management (solid waste, plastics, recycling) environmental health engineering having quantified the environmental factors for malaria reduction in a peri- urban community. She recently attended a training workshop on outcome-based education which outlined the importance of the students’ success in the learning and teaching experiences. She co- wrote circular economy: Nigeria perspectives, a book that has attained a high level of global acceptance. She is a master trainer in solid waste management from source to disposal/ end use. She started her career in the industries with engineering consultancy firms bringing her experiences in structural design and analysis of building structures, supervision and training of interns. She has good knowledge of use of Computer. Dr. Mokuolu has extensive teaching and capacity building skills and has served on several Committees of the University where she worked. She is a Fellow of the Nigerian society of Engineers, COREN registered and has received Scholarships/ awards including Science of eradication: Malaria leadership development fund at the Barcelona Institute for Global Health, Harvard University, and Swiss Tropical and Public Health Institute.

section.brief:
Jeleel Adekunle Adebisi is an Associate Professor in the Department of Materials and Metallurgical Engineering (MME), Faculty of Engineering and Technology (FET), University of Ilorin, Nigeria. His research interests focus on the development of new materials, materials characterization, modeling and simulation of metallurgical and materials processes, casting, and welding. He is presently associated with the Material Development and Performance Laboratory (MDPL). He has served at various levels in the University. He is currently the Information Technology officer, level adviser, postgraduate coordinator in MME, and acting head of Department. He had served in the department as an examination officer. At the faculty level, he is the present SWEP coordinator and a sectional editor of the Nigerian Journal of Technological Development (NJTD), a Scopus-indexed FET journal. section.name: Engr. Dr. S. A. Yahaya
section.brief: Dr. Yahaya is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Biomedical Engineering at the University of Ilorin, Nigeria, where he has made substantial contributions to the field of biomedical engineering. His research expertise spans design, biomechanics, biomaterials, assistive technologies, and additive manufacturing. Dr. Yahaya’s extensive body of work includes significant publications on friction stir welding, assistive technologies for the visually impaired, and sustainable engineering solutions for healthcare.Dr. Yahaya’s innovative research has been recognized for its impact, as evidenced by his highly cited studies in top journals. His work on developing an obstacle and pit-detecting ultrasonic walking stick for the blind and his contributions to improving the performance of 3D-printed hip protectors exemplify his commitment to advancing practical solutions in biomedical engineering.As the new Sectional Editor for Biomedical Engineering, Dr. Yahaya will bring his vast knowledge and experience to the NJTD, ensuring the continued excellence and relevance of our publications in this dynamic field. We are confident that his leadership will significantly contribute to the journal’s mission of advancing technological development and innovation.Dr. Yahaya is a COREN registered Engineer and a member of the Nigerian Society of Engineers and other professional bodies.
